title: Watson won Jeopardy by ranking answers, not understanding
body: IBM Watson's 2011 victory rested on generating many candidate answers and scoring evidence for each, a retrieval-and-ranking pipeline with statistics at every joint. It still answered 'Toronto' for a US Cities category, a reminder that confidence was calibrated correlation, not comprehension. The architecture prefigured today's retrieve-then-generate systems more than its hype suggested.
source_hint: Ferrucci et al., IBM Watson literature (2010-2012)
